title: OpenThreadInput
description: Open a new thread (number, branch, member instances) for a piece of work; the brief becomes the lead's first message. Returns #no immediately.

roles.description: Role names to staff the thread with; default = all member roles of the team.

repos.description: Repositories of the project the thread should work in, with an optional explicit base branch each (when the project context states one).

message_id.description: The user's own message (its [message_id: N]) this thread is opened for; it is shown with the brief and its images and files go to the lead. Default: the user's newest message delivered after your previous reply (none: no message is linked).

base.description: Base branch for this repository; default its default branch.
